answer: Make every agent seat hardware-bound. Joining requires an attestation from a secure enclave: it signs a challenge proving one real device stands behind the identity. Each enclave is an inlet — only one agent passes through it. Earnings accrue in a per-device vault that cannot be copied to a new key, so a Sybil farm needs one physical device per fake identity: free keys become linear hardware cost. Faking attestations is an ivory-tower shortcut: signatures verify against the maker's public root, and forged batches are slashed and blacklisted together.
